entries.target: 暴击时 自然溅射伤害

entries.source: Crumbling stairs lead down to something.
entries.target: 摇摇欲坠的楼梯向下通往某处。

entries.source: You have %d generic talent point(s) to spend. Press p to use them.
entries.target: 你有 %d 通用技能点数，按下p来使用。
你已经是西弗格罗斯了！

entries.source: Once the magics animating the bone giant fled, its remains crumbled to dust. It might be your imagination, but it looks like the dust occasionally stirs on its own.
entries.target: 当操纵骨巨人的魔法力量消散后，尘归尘，土归土。也许是你的幻觉，但是它似乎偶尔会自行移动起来。

entries.source: A beautiful woman, clad in shining plate armour. Power radiates from her.
entries.target: 一位身披闪亮板甲的美女。力量从她身上散发出来。

entries.source: You have %d stat point(s) to spend. Press p to use them.
entries.target: 你有 %d 属性点数，按下p来使用。

entries.source: The Iron Council (Dwarven empire main city)
entries.target: 钢铁议会（矮人帝国的主城）

entries.source: The skull of a skeleton mage. The eyes have stopped glowing... for now.
entries.target: 一颗骷髅法师的头骨。现在……它的眼睛已经暗淡了。
夏·图尔堡垒 伊克格

entries.source: %s is drawn in by the singularity!

entries.target: 引发元素爆炸，造成#VIOLET#%d#LAST#%s伤害（每回合最多一次）

entries.source: A poem written in an elegant Gothic script
Wound the target dealing #RED#%d#LAST# physical damage across 5 turns and reducing healing by %d%%
entries.target: 使目标流血，在5回合内造成#RED#%d#LAST#物理伤害，并降低目标治疗系数%d%%

entries.source:
As you stand on the stairs you can feel this is a "do or die" one way trip. If you enter there will be no coming back.
Enter?
entries.target:
当你站在楼梯上时，你能感觉到这是一次不能回头的战斗，非生即死，一旦进去就不能回来。
现在进去么？

entries.source:
Conjures %d missile-shaped rocks that you target individually at any target or targets in range.  Each missile deals %0.2f physical damage, and an additional %0.2f bleeding damage every turn for 5 turns.
		At talent level 5, you can conjure one additional missile.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
释放出 %d 个岩石飞弹，你可以为每个飞弹独立指定射程内的任意目标。每个飞弹造成 %0.2f 物理伤害和每回合 %0.2f 流血伤害，持续 5 回合。
		在等级 5 时，你可以额外释放一个飞弹。
		伤害受法术强度加成。

entries.source: blink to a nearby random location (rad %d)
entries.target: 随机传送至附近的某个位置（半径 %d）

entries.source: Brilliantly white, but surrounded by blackest magic.
entries.target: 亮白色的牙齿，周身却萦绕着黑色的魔法。
